adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 43 in AddGuestsDialog.tsx: `const message = \`${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}\`;` - This creates a string using template literals. Even if `err.data?.code` is undefined, the string will be 'undefined: <translated message>' which is truthy. The fallback `message || t("unable_to_add_guests")` will never trigger because the template literal always produces a non-empty string. This means users could see 'undefined: ...' in error messages, which is a real bug.
